description: This file is a shell script that provides a testing framework and utility functions for performance testing of Git repositories. It includes setup for environment variables, repository creation, symlink configurations, and timing tests, among others.

methods.name: die_if_build_dir_not_repo
methods.description: Checks if the build directory is a Git repository; terminates with error if not.

methods.name: test_perf_copy_repo_contents
methods.description: Copies repository contents while skipping certain directories and files.

methods.name: test_perf_create_repo_from
methods.description: Creates a Git repository by copying from a source repository, preserving structure and configurations.

methods.name: test_perf_fresh_repo
methods.description: Initializes a new, empty Git repository with appropriate configuration.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Creates a repository based on GIT_PERF_REPO, suitable for testing.

methods.name: test_perf_large_repo
methods.description: Creates a large repository for performance testing, based on GIT_PERF_LARGE_REPO.

methods.name: test_checkout_worktree
methods.description: Checks out all files into the worktree from Git index.

methods.name: test_run_perf_
methods.description: Executes a performance testing command with timing and environment management.
